findings.observation: Late ordinary stop overwrites already closed ended_at in either direction.
findings.qualification: Existing end is trustworthy for the same interval; incoming event is not an authorized historical correction. Universal min(timestamp) is not approved.

findings.observation: Earlier arriving-in-late-order start is clamped to the current later interval start, losing its original operational boundary.
Close helper selects open matching reasons without start<=close bound or explicit trip/interval causal scope.
Ordinary excavator loading closes all collected open excavator intervals at load time even after detecting later-started downtime.
Nonblocking load authority does not itself approve broad closure of truck Repair/Fueling/etc. R17 remains an explicit policy boundary.
Settings face change starts transfer and replaces active intervals at server time, contrary to explicit-start R19.
Existing already_closed guard preserves closed interval. Open interval command requires global version equality and uses receipt-side now rather than immutable action time.

policy_boundaries: R17/R01: Which non-wait manual causes does physical loading close, for each machine?
R19: Effect of explicit transfer start on already active manual downtime is not approved merely by R19 explicit start.
R03: Allocation of actions physically after administrative shift close needs its own authority.
Work interval category Repair is distinct from physical equipment maintenance release authority.
